menu.welcome_text:
👋 Welcome to the giveaway bot!

Add the bot as a channel admin — it will appear in “My channels”, and creating a giveaway takes a couple of taps.

Choose an action below.
menu.support: 💬 Support: @Som_teg Describe the problem and attach a screenshot.
menu.invited_notice: 🎉 Someone joined via your link! Total invited: {invited}
menu.help_text: ❓ How this bot works 1. Add the bot as a channel admin (with “Post messages”). 2. “🎉 Create giveaway” → channel → text → media → winners → time. 3. Publish the post: people tap the button under it. 🎁 “Invite” gives your referral link for friends. Commands: /start, /help, /mydata, /cancel.
menu.delete_confirm: Delete your data? Your entries in active giveaways will be removed and referral links broken.

common.error: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.stale: This button is outdated. Open the step again.
common.unsupported: This message type is not supported. Send text, a photo, a video, a GIF or a document.

draw.prompt_chat:
Forward a post from the channel or send its @username / t.me/... link.

You must be a channel admin, and the bot must be an admin too.
draw.prompt_text:
Send the post text. HTML markup is supported.

Up to 4096 characters (or up to 1024 if you add media).
draw.prompt_media: Send a photo, video, GIF or document for the post. If you don't need media, tap “No media”.
draw.prompt_winners: How many winners? Send a number from 1 to {max}.
draw.prompt_start: When should the giveaway start? Send date and time, e.g. 31.12 18:00, in your time zone {tz}, or tap “Now”.
draw.prompt_end: When should the giveaway end? Send date and time, e.g. 31.12 18:00 ({tz}), or pick a quick option.
draw.prompt_btn: Send the join button text (up to 40 characters).
draw.prompt_max: Maximum number of participants? Send 0 for no limit.
draw.need_media: Send a photo, video, GIF, document or tap “No media”.
draw.caption_too_long: Media caption is too long: {n} of {limit} characters.
draw.text_too_long: Text is too long: {n} of {limit} characters.
draw.media_caption_long: With media the caption cannot exceed 1024 characters (currently {n}).
draw.bad_range: A number from 1 to {max} is required.
draw.over_time: This time is already in the past.
draw.end_before_start: The end must be later than the start.
draw.button_too_long: Button text must be 1 to 40 characters long.
draw.bad_max: A number from 0 to 1,000,000 is required.
draw.chat_not_found: Could not find the channel. Forward a post, send @username or a t.me/... link.
draw.bad_chat: This is a private chat. A channel or group is required.
draw.not_admin: You must be an admin of this channel.
draw.bot_not_admin: Add the bot as a channel admin and try again.
draw.bot_cant_post: The bot has no permission to post in this channel.
draw.not_editable: This giveaway cannot be changed in its current status.
draw.prompt_target: How many participants should trigger the end? Send a number from 1 to 1,000,000.
draw.prompt_mode:
🏁 How should the giveaway end?

⏰ By time — on the specified date.
👥 By participants — when the target number is reached.
⏰+👥 Both — whichever comes first.
draw.need_target: Set the participant target in the giveaway settings.
draw.winners_over_target: Winners ({winners}) exceed the participant target ({target}). Lower the winner count or raise the target.
draw.private_channel_note: ℹ️ This is a private channel: the post link will look like t.me/c/... and works for subscribers only.

subs.prompt: Forward a post from the channel or send its @username / t.me/... link that users must subscribe to.
subs.limit: You can add at most {n} channels.
subs.pick: 📣 Pick a channel users must subscribe to:
subs.no_more: No channels available to add. Add the bot as an admin to the channel and tap “🔄 Refresh”.

my.no_draws: You have no giveaways yet. Tap “Create giveaway” to start.

confirm.del: Delete giveaway #{id}? This cannot be undone.
confirm.rr: Redraw giveaway #{id}? Winners will be picked again.
confirm.rrx: Redraw giveaway #{id} excluding previous winners? If there are not enough new participants, winners will be picked from everyone.
confirm.cancel: Cancel giveaway #{id}? Joining will be closed.

channels.title:
📣 Channels where the bot is an admin

Pick a channel for the giveaway:
channels.empty:
📣 The bot does not see any channels yet.

1. Add the bot as a channel admin (with permission to post messages).
2. Tap “🔄 Refresh”.

You can also send the channel @username or forward a post from it.
channels.how: Add the bot as a channel admin: Channel settings → Administrators → Add → pick the bot → enable “Post messages”. After that the channel appears here automatically.
channels.not_admin: You are not an admin of this channel.
channels.added: ✅ Channel “{title}” is connected. It is now available for giveaways.

quick.custom_winners: Send the number of winners from 1 to {max}.
quick.custom_start: Send the start date and time, e.g. 31.12 18:00 ({tz}).
quick.custom_end: Send the end date and time, e.g. 31.12 18:00 ({tz}).
quick.custom_max: Send the participant limit (0 for no limit).
quick.custom_target: Send the target number of participants (1 to 1,000,000).
